corrections: Reception eligibility uses a reachable incoming free-ball trajectory, including descending arrivals, even when proximity statistics already say possession.

Physical actors no longer use the legacy controlled-collision wildcard to cushion a ball during an idle or movement animation. Native action contacts and swept weighted-skin body collisions remain authoritative.
A deferred native protective step survives animation requeue processing after a hard running reversal. Straight approved locomotion and running kick regressions remain separate checks.

Confirmed quick possession may choose a safe defensive outlet immediately, instead of waiting 350ms until a native pass has already started. Non-native tactical decisions are logged at selection time so short opportunities are not lost to periodic sampling.
CPU receives a fast incoming pass before distribution; contextual circulation, box runs, bounded carrying speed, and rotation before backward passes supplement native maximum-level AI.
Goalkeepers can close uncovered one-on-ones, control intentional backpasses with feet, and play a native unreachable-shot dive with no fabricated ball-contact event.

Match messages and goal counts are published as snapshot data. Caption redraws, shared FreeType font operations and visibility changes now belong to the graphics phase, removing concurrent simulation/graphics GUI writes.
Attacking aerial arrivals near the opponent goal preserve the original native first-time finish/pass choices instead of always forcing a trap.

Explicit human H/LT holds now suppress competing reception magnets and follow the nearby opponent while preserving manual input and physical traction. A nearest-ball-owner check keeps possession protection unchanged; camera possession hysteresis alone is not used to choose the hold stance.
32 different bounded upper-body curve families generate 6274 parameter profiles. Native roots, legs and touch events remain authoritative.
fixture_corrections: The tackle log cursor now starts before the setup key acknowledgement: an already-running native slide can contact a leg during that acknowledged frame. Collision, fall and foul assertions remain unchanged.

A random 45-second segment need not offer an open safe outlet. The tactical smoke now also prepares open defensive lanes, then requires the native CPU to select a safe buildout/circulation option and execute an actual pass. Only initial positions change; no decision, contact or outcome is awarded.

The unattended HUD stress fixes the match seed and lets CPU take native restarts; the long AI observation also uses CPU restarts so a manual human throw-in cannot stall the clock test. Shipped human restart behavior is tested separately.

Sustained grip tests retain at least five traction samples, real hand reach, reciprocal force limits, measured escape slowdown and a 500ms hold minimum. The final controller fix stabilizes deliberate holding instead of widening joint limits.
limitations: Graphical tests run Linux/X11 with a virtual Xbox controller. Windows is cross-compiled and its portable binary, imports and assets are verified; no Windows GUI or physical controller is executed here.
This is a finite collection of short scenarios, not exhaustive gameplay coverage or a complete 90-minute soak.
6274 profiles and 28632 mirrored candidate pairs are procedural parameter variations over existing clips, not new motion-captured animations or a learned physical policy.

Allocator-preload diagnostics were used while investigating the earlier exit failure; they are not complete source AddressSanitizer instrumentation or a proof that all possible memory errors are absent.
Articulated bodies, member capsules, weighted skin and clothing remain physical approximations. They do not guarantee perfect contacts in every possible pose.
